function.name: get_weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date range. The forecast includes temperature, precipitation, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, Country' (e.g., 'London, UK').

start_date.description: The start date of the period for the weather forecast in the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-04-01').

end_date.description: The end date of the period for the weather forecast in the ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-04-07').

units.description: The unit system in which to return the weather forecast data.

include_details.description: Specifies whether to include detailed forecast information such as humidity and visibility.

• Correlation engine that maps dependencies regardless of provider. | | **Continuous Performance Optimization** – keep latency, throughput, CPU/memory usage within SLA while avoiding over‑provisioning.| Keeps customer experience high and infrastructure spend low.| • AI/ML “decision engine” runs continuously against live metrics.

**Policy‑Driven Remediation** | ✔️ | Limited (manual scripting required) | | **Vendor Neutrality** | ✔️ | ❌ | | **Ease of Adoption (multi‑team)** | Moderate (initial config) | Easy for single‑provider teams | | **Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** | Higher upfront license, lower operational cost due to savings | Lower license, higher ops cost due to inefficiencies | --- ## Suggested Implementation Roadmap for Unilever 1. **Discovery Phase** - Run Turbonomic Discovery Agent on a subset of workloads spanning GCP, AWS, Azure. - Map out current resource allocation, performance baselines, cost distribution. 2. **Define Objectives & Success Criteria** - Target % reduction in idle capacity. - Desired MTTR improvement. - Budget adherence goals. 3. **Pilot Project** - Pick a critical application tier (e.g., marketing campaign microsite). - Enable Turbonomic’s autonomous mode temporarily. - Measure baseline vs post‑pilot metrics. 4. **Scale Up** - Roll out to additional tiers **Turbonomic turns raw telemetry into actionable intelligence** that spans *all* your clouds, turning reactive maintenance into proactive optimization. - Unlike native cloud tools—which excel at platform‑centric monitoring—they fall short on cross‑cloud orchestration, AI‑powered recommendations, and centralized policy enforcement. - For a multinational consumer goods company like Unilever, adopting Turbonomic means tighter cost controls, smoother service delivery, and a scalable foundation ready for whatever new cloud technologies emerge tomorrow.
